meta.name: ai-competitor-profiling
meta.description: 竞品画像助手适合内容创作者、市场营销、运营、内容媒体在用户提出“对手强在哪里”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成转化问题优先级、可复制改稿、实验或跟进行动清单。

copy.tagline: 快速拆解竞品优势，生成可执行的改稿与行动清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要分析对手内容并快速产出改进方案
copy.tagline_en: Quickly dissect competitor strengths and generate actionable improvement lists
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to analyze competitors and produce actionable improvements

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成竞品画像助手。当你提供竞品材料或问题，它会分析并输出：竞品转化问题优先级、可复制改稿、实验或跟进行动清单。
howto.when: 当你提出“对手强在哪里”这类问题，并提供了处理目标、使用对象、参考链接等材料时触发。

say.text: 分析这篇竞品文章，给出可复制的改稿建议。
对比我和对手的落地页，列出实验优先级。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a competitor profiling assistant. When you provide competitor materials or questions, it analyzes and outputs: competitor conversion issue priorities, replicable copy edits, experiments, or follow-up action lists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like 'What makes the competitor strong?' and provide processing goals, target audience, reference links, etc.

say_en.text: Analyze this competitor article and give replicable copy suggestions.
Compare my landing page with the competitor's, list experiment priorities.
